source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"An activity reserved for elected officials because practicing nurses should not contribute clinical expertise to laws affecting nursing practice.","B":"A role limited to professional associations because individual nurses have no appropriate place in policy discussions about scope and standards.","C":"An activity unrelated to patient care because Nurse Practice Act changes affect professional regulation but not healthcare delivery or safety.","D":"Professional advocacy, using nursing expertise to inform policy and regulation that shape scope of practice, standards, and safe patient care."}}
source_row.rationale: Nurse involvement in advocacy efforts related to Nurse Practice Act updates reflects an important aspect of professional engagement, since practicing nurses possess valuable clinical expertise that can inform policy decisions shaping the scope of practice and standards of the profession, ultimately affecting patient access to care and quality.
source_row.source_detail: ANA Advocacy: legislative/political advocacy is a pillar of nursing; nurses’ expertise should inform public policy and rules that affect patients and the profession. Current ANA advocacy page reviewed 2026-08-15. Reviewed 2026-08-15.
source_row.source_name: ANA — Nurse Advocacy and Policy Engagement
source_row.stem: A nurse participates in advocacy efforts to update their state's Nurse Practice Act to reflect current, evidence-based nursing practice standards. This type of involvement reflects:
